review_scope: Independent final source review of unintegrated selected-child-in-memory exact LP allocation engine

functions.setWeight: Checks ordinal/aggregate overflow and strict no-op. Settles each OLD-weight asset path, persists inherited whole leaf units in addition to preexisting rights, then mutates leaf and bottom-up weights/rebases. Both books finish under old weights before any weight changes.
functions.credit: Constant root writes and checked outstanding/pending addition; positive funding needs nonempty root; zero is no-op; no lifetime accumulator that could block repeated credit/drain cycles. Does not verify actual asset backing.
functions.claimable: Adds existing pending plus incoming parent split on each selected path; skips zero total amount before division; final leaf includes old whole rights even when current weight is zero. No real state writes.
functions.take: Validates ordinal, settles selected path without transient selected-child storage, combines inherited amount with preexisting leaf, clears only preexisting leaf and debits outstanding. No external calls/payout/owner logic.
functions.totalWeight/weightOf/outstanding: Read only currently stored internal counters; ordinal validation on leaf lookup. No external NFT, share, token or lifecycle verification.
functions.split: Math.mulDiv/mulmod keep full precision. Valid low<W and uint128 high<Q. Low gap fold never adds an overflowing sum. Phase<2Q; if L=W or0 no extra allocation; otherwise floor quotient<=A-1 so carry increment<=A. Right=A-left exact whole conservation.
functions._rebase: For valid state low<oldW, floor(low*newW/oldW)<newW; high retained even through empty weight. Fractional fairness-phase reduction <1/(Q*newW) for positive target or<1/Q when target0. Not an integer payout bound.
functions._leaf: Explicit ordinal1..1000, maps into1024..2023; padding2024..2047 never receives an admitted positive leaf weight.
functions._settlePath: At each fixed-depth node merges checked stored+inherited, clears only preexisting node pending, splits/updates carry only for positive total, writes only sibling allocation and passes selected amount in memory. Final leaf is untouched. This reproduces original final pending/carry state without transient selected writes; no external call can observe in-flight missing pending.

critical_policy_limits: Hierarchical allocation is not identical to flat proportional/largest-remainder rounding.
High+low carry limits weight-update FAIRNESS PHASE truncation, not whole-unit payout differences. The exact-threshold1/3 -> total4 -> total6, credit4 vector can defer one unit.
Fixed-weight batching/claim-order invariance is relative to the stored phase; dynamic weight changes need explicit reviewed semantics.
Two enum books are logical ETH/ZZZ identities only; host must bind actual assets, authenticate funding/ordinals/buckets/current owners, synchronize exact Vault denominators and retain lifecycles.

Internal storage invariants presume all ordinary writers use this engine. Future canonical import must validate weights, low denominators, carry bounds, pending/outstanding and restore weights BEFORE carry/money without replaying resets.
No fixed-point money reserve exists in this engine. Carry is future rounding phase; only pending/outstanding are money.
New internal-library shell normal size is not future integrated Rewards/Vault code size or operating gas approval.

optimization_reasoning.behavioral_scope: Final complete tree state should equal baseline after every valid operation, not merely current claim amounts.
optimization_reasoning.before: Selected child allocation was stored, read at next level, then deleted during path push.
optimization_reasoning.after: Selected allocation stays in a local variable until final leaf; only sibling needs persistence.
optimization_reasoning.checked_merge: The original selected-child SSTORE addition and new next-node local addition contain the same nonnegative terms; any overflow still reverts whole operation.
optimization_reasoning.zero_case: No merged amount means no split/division/carry change, including dormant zero-weight paths.
optimization_reasoning.leaf_case: take consumes inherited plus old leaf; setWeight persists inherited plus old leaf before changing weight, including new weight zero.
optimization_reasoning.evidence_boundary: Actual full-node old/new differential and cold execution gas tests are owned separately by accounting agent; this record itself is source reasoning only.
optimization_reasoning.gas_boundary: Execution gasleft samples/refunds are not full host/intrinsic/network fee qualification.
